title.narrative: Capacity-building to establish an integrated and enhanced transparency framework in Uzbekistan to track the national climate actions and support measures received

description.narrative: 1. Beyond the global and environmental benefits already stated, this project is expected to bring direct socio-economic benefts to several beneficiaries working within key institiutions in Uzbekistan due to the capacity building interventions that will be the result of the GEF intervention through this CBIT project. Approximate numbers of people expecting to benefit are listed as follows. Table 1.
